title: Maximum Difference Between Adjacent Elements in a Circular Array
summary: Determine the greatest absolute difference between consecutive elements in a circular array where the first and last elements are considered adjacent.
statement: Determine the greatest absolute difference between consecutive elements in a circular array where the first and last elements are considered adjacent.
constraints: Treat the first and last array elements as adjacent as well as ordinary neighboring pairs.
Compute the absolute difference for every circular edge.
reference_solution:
def maximum_circular_adjacent_difference(nums):
    return max(abs(value-nums[(i+1)%len(nums)]) for i,value in enumerate(nums))
hints: Enumerate each index as the left endpoint of one circular edge.
Use modulo n to wrap the successor of the final index to zero.
The maximum over these n edges covers every adjacent circular pair exactly once.
editorial: The maximum over these n edges covers every adjacent circular pair exactly once.

tests.explanation: The circular edge from four back to one has difference three, the maximum.
Both circular edges have difference zero.
